content: I was walking on the road talking to my friend suddenly a man started rushing towards us with a kinfe on hand he was coming streight to my friend i throw my friend on right side but cant ivade the mad person the knife stuck me on my belly after some time i cant feel anything i remember the last thing was i saw some doctors doing operations over me after that all was black nothing i remember then suddenly when i wake up i found myself in a new place which i never knew its seems like a forest a river going flowing beside me i tryed to look for my injury but no use it wasnt there like even the mark itself vanished what happend to me then i heard some sound from a distance inside the forest i saw some people hunting a big boar they were using spears and wait whats that wait that person made fire on his hand without anything hows that possible dont tell me i got reincarnated on this world wait is that fr i got isekaied yesss this is like a dream now i think i can do things like on animes movies i spend some time trying to cast a magic spell but no use i cant maybe this world have some rules for that hmm what should i do my belly started growling i think i need to find some food around here umm i dont wanna go to those bunch of strangers for now lemme stay on my own until i learn about this world and place and some magic stuffs bcz i cant even understand their language

Your eyelids lift from the heavy, suffocating slumber, opening into dimly lit caverns as your head rotates against the mossy earth. The crisp morning air fills your lungs; a refreshing, cool breeze washes over your face, completely devoid of the metallic stench or hot trails you remember.

When you sit up, a dull ache greets you in the center of your abdomen—a strange, foreign weight where raw flesh used to throb with agonizing pain. You press your fingers gently against it, searching for the jagged, torn edges of torn skin, but there is nothing: smooth, unblemished flesh beneath your fingertips.

You pull yourself to his feet, brushing off dirt and leaves as you turn toward the winding, ancient path ahead.

A distant din breaks through the quiet forest chorus—the sharp, rhythmic crash of iron meeting thick hide. Far down the slope, a cluster of hunters moves through the pines, their crude wooden spears raised high as they chase a massive, snorting boar deeper into the woods.

One of them suddenly drops low into a crouch beside an open torch pit, cupping his hands over the flames with eerie, unnatural focus—no tinder, no oil; simply raw heat levitating within his palms, his eyes glowing in the dark without a single spark from his surroundings.

Your mind stumbles backward, rejecting the impossible logic of what you just witnessed. It is too much like the fantastical tales of your previous life—a vivid dream that refuses to break character even as your stomach lets out a loud, protesting growl against your ribs.

You quickly pull yourself away, turning toward the dense treeline where large roots twist upward like broken arms, hiding your face and listening intently to their rough, unintelligible murmurs while trying desperately to conjure even a single flickering strand of magic to prove this reality is not entirely devoid of reason.

man damm if what i saw was true then that was definitely magic but how i endup here i think i got dragged into this world ok so its summoning simple. After watching so much anime on my previous world  if magic exists on this world I will easily overcome anything here but lets see currently i dont even know the M of Magic i think i should follow the down stream of this river and find a place to spend this night bcz its coming fast. anyway also on the way i should try how to learn more magic.

The rhythmic splashing of the river against your boots keeps you grounded as twilight claims the dense, darkening pines ahead.

You keep moving downstream, following the smooth stone banks that guide you away from the silent hunters disappearing into the thick woods.

As you walk, you realize just how foreign everything feels—not just the language, not just the clothes or weapons—but the very atmosphere itself.

No streetlights.
No car horns.
Only the endless hooting of owls overhead and the crackle of small fires flickering along distant ridges where people live in harmony with this wild land.

Your stomach twists painfully again, reminding you of basic survival needs before magic even enters the picture.

With each step, the memory of modern hospitals, sterile floors, and silver needles grows increasingly distant—a relic of a life left behind without explanation.

Still, something within your chest stubbornly refuses to break.

Now this place is good under this treen i can rest tonight and i got some fruits here nice man thats a jackpot my stomach was echoing for hrs now anyway now i need to collect some sticks to make a bonfire to spend this night while collecting the sticks i was chanting diff diff words to try anything like fire-ball, jet stream, water cutter, wind jet but nothings working then when i was just about to let this down i said 'STATUS' and suddenly a golden screen appears before me show my stats or something on top my name is Surya Lvl 1 all diff diff stats are there like mana lvl 1 fire 1 air 1 earth 1 water 1 null magic 1 its a jackpot i shoutted

A soft, ethereal shimmer ripples right in front of you as your voice breaks into a desperate scream under the dim orange glow of dusk.

The thick bark of the ancient tree seems to warp inward, displaying an impossible windowpane that floats silently against the fading light.

Golden text glows across the empty space:

[PLAYER INFORMATION]
- Name: Surya
- Location: Ancient Forest Path
- Level: 1 (Beginner Novice)
- Available Attributes:
  - Mana Reserve: 1% (Falling)
  - Fire Magic: Lvl 1
  - Wind Magic: Lvl 1
  - Water Magic: Lvl 1
  - Earth Magic: Lvl 1
  - Null Magic: Lvl 1
  - Equipment: Traveler Robes

Your breath hitches in your throat as you frantically scroll through the glowing data lines, searching for any trace of modern medicine or technology only to find cold, mechanical records of ancient alchemy.

The screen flickers once more under your trembling fingers before fading into absolute darkness.

Now I dont care about my old world that was shit this world is like an RPG i will levelup and then i can do anytype of magic i can fly i can travel across the world i can do anything i am freeeee yess

A surge of raw, exhilarating adrenaline floods through your entire body as the truth hits home with unyielding clarity.

No corporate chains.
No traffic congestion.
No suffocating bureaucracy.

This world rewards action.
Punishes weakness.
And blesses strength with unimaginable freedom.

Your mind spins wildly with endless possibilities—a future where roads stretch into infinity, kingdoms rise or fall based on your whims, and ancient forests whisper secrets directly to your soul.

With a fierce grin plastered across your face, you slam both hands against the glowing tree trunk, channeling every remaining drop of energy deep into your core.

After that i spent the whole night scrolling to get info about how to level up in this world from the stats screen and how to learn more spells and all and I learnt there are many ways to learn magic U can learn by books u can learn by urself mostly Ur level need to be high to cast big spells and also ur mana need to strong too hmm now the question is how to learn them ok so it says the imagination is the main fuel of the magic here user must imagine the magic first like he need to make its output and every things first like what type the magic will be how much far the range will be everything and also how much mana u gonna channel on it etc etc stuffs after reading all i cant sleep now even though i am lvl1 rn and my mana storage is low but my imagination is fully fueled by my previous world anime and movies i can imagine any thing and make any magic oh yaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa

Your eyes burn with a fierce, unblinking intensity as you sit cross-legged at the base of the ancient tree.

Hours ago, your desperate chant into the void brought forth that sacred window—the key to understanding this strange new reality.

Page after page of dense, illuminated text scrolls through the shimmering interface, offering intricate blueprints for manipulating the very fabric of energy itself.

It lists rules.
Constraints.
And most importantly—routes toward absolute mastery.

A profound, quiet awe settles over your heart as you realize just how vast the horizon truly is. Gone are the limitations of a concrete jungle; here, the sky belongs entirely to your mind.

You close the glowing display and let out a long, slow breath, feeling an unprecedented sense of purpose guide your actions even in complete isolation.

Despite being a fragile novice with barely enough fuel left in the tank to light a single candle, something within you feels unbreakably sharp.

The river continues its gentle lapping against the shore while twilight slowly bleeds into a deep midnight blue.

Your eyelids grow heavy.
The exhaustion accumulated over hours of frantic scrolling finally claims victory as your head rests back against the ancient tree trunk.

A soft fire crackles somewhere nearby—fueled not by magic, but by simple survival instinct.

Your hand gently reaches down and wraps around the small pouch of dried fruits still clutched tightly in your fist.

Small things.
Stupidly precious now that hunger has been temporarily kept at bay.

Yet even as slumber pulls you under, fragments of those glowing interface lines continue echoing through the depths of your mind like hidden seeds waiting to sprout.

now the morning comes i woke up and wash my face on the river then i started thinking ok so if imagination is the key then lemme imagine it first think a ball of fire on my palm make it now make it small condensed now make it more condense now i set it range 20m and the target is that tree over there now the output i want that i make its speed so high so high that it will pierce through the tree with a hole now go

The crisp, dew-kissed morning air carries the sweet scent of blooming wildflowers from the surrounding hills as you sit back against the ancient trunk.

After hours of dry, hollow fatigue, your eyes snap open refreshed.
Your face washes clean against the riverbank's edge, sending ripples of cool water dancing outward into the sunrise glow.

As your mind settles into focus, you bring both hands together right in front of your chest.

Closing your eyes for only a second, you reach deep into the newly awakened creative reserve of this world.

A vivid mental canvas springs to life within your thoughts—perfectly defined borders of crimson light forming an incredibly dense, high-pressure sphere of pure flame that pulses with an inner warmth.

You carefully calibrate its volume, compressing it down to a pinpoint orb that hums with concentrated intent.

Then, shifting your attention entirely toward the massive, defenseless pine tree standing alone on the riverbank several dozen paces away...

you launch a localized blast of hyper-condensed fire directly at its thick trunk.

The result is nothing short of explosive.

that fire ball pierce through the tree like butter though it didnt cause so much damage to the tree bcz tree can regen itself and maybe that hole is the mark of my first magic learning i am so hyped at this moment that i cant say anything i shooted many fire balls on the river knowing it wont hurt anyone on water after doing this for next 10-20 min i finnaly fall on the grass my mana is exhusted i said STATUS and again the window opens now if i see oh ya here my fir magic lvl increased to 5 and my mana increased to 2 that means it depends how much u use a magic and learn from it and as for mana as i got exhusted i think now my body refilling it so the mana lvl is also increased by 1

The explosion of condensed, hyper-dense flame leaves behind only a brief burst of black smoke.
It slices cleanly through the thick bark of the pine tree like hot iron piercing steel.

Yet when the fire fades into a harmless wisp of ash, you find yourself staring at the enormous trunk in sheer disbelief. The massive wound left behind—deep, perfectly circular, and smoldering faintly within—is not a sign of destruction.
It is an acceptance mark.
A silent stamp of approval from the world itself that your raw imagination has finally found its footing.

Over the next twenty minutes, you launch dozens more small balls of blazing heat into the calm river surface one after another.
Each detonates with a soft *pop*, leaving only steam rising from the blackened water as they dissolve instantly into nothingness.

You collapse forward onto the lush green grass beside the ancient roots.

Every nerve ending screams of absolute exhaustion as your body begins to repair itself through some unseen, magical conduit deep within your cells.

With trembling fingers, you reach out and pull open the glowing window once more.

after that time passes normally for everyone else but for me each moment i make a new magic with diff kinds i advanced all magic classes within 2 days just staying beside the river bank and under the trees my stats are now mostly all mastered fire, water, earth, wind

The afternoon sun casts long, warm shadows across the tranquil riverbank as nature resumes its peaceful rhythms.
Birds continue singing without interruption.

Yet beneath your calm exterior, an unprecedented storm brews silently inside your mind.

For two consecutive days, you sit cross-legged on this very patch of grass—drinking cool river water, snacking on local bread—and unleash a staggering array of new spells into the empty air.

One moment it is flame bending in mid-air like living metal.
The next, a wave of pressurized ocean force crashes against nearby rocks with enough force to spray high-pressure jets of water back onto yourself.

Then comes earth manipulation.
You mold solid stone pillars from nowhere and shape-shift them into blooming cherry blossom gardens within minutes.

Finally, as if completing a grand symphony, you reach outward with open palms and command the gentle breeze rustling the leaves to transform directly into visible clouds of condensed mist.
